sloka: सा राक्षसानाम् प्रवरेण बाला ।स्व शील सम्रक्षण तत् परा सती ।अनेन नूनम् प्रतिदुष्ट कर्मणा ।हता भवेद् आर्य पथे परे स्थिता ॥५-१२-३॥
transliteration: sā rākṣasānām pravareṇa bālā ।sva śīla samrakṣaṇa tat parā satī ।anena nūnam pratiduṣṭa karmaṇā ।hatā bhaved ārya pathe pare sthitā ॥5-12-3॥

translations.english: 'Janaki, follower of noble path, anxious to protect her chastity must have been killed by the wicked demon king.
